purpose: Copy chosen tables of the Meridian Pay production data to a place where our analytics vendor can take them every night.

components.name: analytics read replica (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: The analytics read replica (PostgreSQL) is a read-only copy of the production database, and it is the single source of the sync-job.

components.name: staging bucket (S3)
components.evidence: The bucket where the extract files are put. The vendor downloads the files from here.

components.name: Analytics vendor
components.evidence: The external company which loads our files to its own warehouse.

flows.evidence: The job open a connection to the replica and read the tables from the list of the configuration.
For every table it write one extract file with a temporary name into the staging bucket
The vendor downloads the final files in the morning.
